QuestInfo.name: The Worst Rope Ever
QuestInfo.0: You're going to need rope to climb out.
QuestInfo.1: You should be able to make it up to the #p9074402# by making rope out of #o9810403# tails. Get 10 to make a long enough rope.
QuestInfo.2: This rope is terribly smelly, but it should work.

0.0: I don't have a rope with me, but that doesn't mean I can't make one! #o9810403# tails might work. Maybe if I got 10 #t4033217#s strung them together, I could get out of here. And then I could use it to hogtie #p9074402# for getting me stuck in here in the first place!

item.0: I could make a rope out of Werewolf Tails... I think.
